messages.sourceEnglish: Review automatic crop plans from your own growing estimates and saved buyer targets.
messages.text: Tsedzulusani pulane dza zwilimwa dza othomethiki dzi tshi bva kha mbalo dzaṋu dza u alusa na zwipikwa zwo vhulungwaho zwa vharengi.

messages.sourceEnglish: Check dated nursery tray and surface needs before downloading your review.
messages.text: Tolani thirei dza nese dzi re na datumu na zwidodombedzwa zwa vhupo musi ni sa athu daunilouda tsedzuluso yaṋu.

messages.sourceEnglish: Save your own growing estimates and review capacity and dates for measured beds.
messages.text: Vhulungani mbalo dzaṋu dza u alusa nahone ni tsedzuluso vhukoni na madatumu a mibethe yo pimiwaho.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a crop plan from your estimates
messages.text: Tsedzulusani pulane ya zwilimwa i tshi bva kha mbalo dzaṋu

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.text: Mupulani wa zwilimwa → Pulane ya othomethiki i tshi bva kha mbalo dzaṋu

messages.sourceEnglish: Check your saved design, confirm availability and match buyer targets to your growing estimates. Review the proposed cycles and nursery needs; your saved sowings remain unchanged.
messages.text: Tolani ndinganyo yo vhulungwaho, khwathisedzani u vha hone nahone ni fanyise zwipikwa zwa vharengi na mbalo dzaṋu dza u alusa. Tsedzulusani mitingatingo yo dzinginywaho na zwidodombedzwa zwa nese; nyalo dzaṋu dzo vhulungwaho a dzi shanduki.
Tsedzulusani mbalo dzaṋu dza u alusa
Mupulani wa zwilimwa → Mbalo dzaṋu dza u alusa

messages.sourceEnglish: Enter your own assumptions, choose a measured bed and review the calculation. Blank values stay missing; the result is an estimate, not local farming approval.
messages.text: Dzhenisani mihumbulo yaṋu, nangani mbethe wo pimiwaho nahone ni tsedzuluso mbalelo. Mbalo dzi siho dzi dzula dzi siho; mvelelo ndi mbalo fhedzi, a si thendelo ya vhulimi ha henefho.
